fixture_driver_source:
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time,uuid
root=pathlib.Path('/home/klukas.guest/build/ckutilities-files-20261023-01a165ae')
os.environ['TMPDIR']=str(root/'tmp')
mode=sys.argv[1]
assert mode in {'normal','sanitizer'} and os.geteuid()==0
fixture=root/'tmp'/('location-relation-mounts-'+str(uuid.uuid4()))
fixture.mkdir(mode=0o700)
for name in ['source','alias','other']:(fixture/name).mkdir()
executable=root/('build/tests/unit/ck_files/ck_files_native_tests' if mode=='normal' else 'location-relation-final-sanitizer/ck-files-location-relation-tests')
record=dict(mode=mode,fixture=str(fixture),mount_namespace=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/mnt'),executable=str(executable),sha256=hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),mount_commands=[],cleanup=[])
mounted=[]
try:
 for command,target in [(['mount','--bind',str(fixture/'source'),str(fixture/'alias')],fixture/'alias'),(['mount','-t','tmpfs','-o','size=1m,nodev,nosuid,noexec','tmpfs',str(fixture/'other')],fixture/'other')]:
  subprocess.run(command,check=True);mounted.append(target);record['mount_commands'].append(command)
 record['mountinfo']=[line for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if str(fixture) in line]
 os.environ['CKTOOLS_LOCATION_RELATION_FIXTURE']=str(fixture)
 os.environ['ASAN_OPTIONS']='halt_on_error=1:detect_leaks=1'
 os.environ['UBSAN_OPTIONS']='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'
 start=time.monotonic();record['start']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 result=subprocess.run([str(executable),'--suite','test_files_location_relation_native.cpp'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,cwd=root/'source')
 record.update(exit_code=result.returncode,end=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3),output=result.stdout)
 print(result.stdout,flush=True)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Private mount fixture tests failed')
 if 'same-volume bind mount and distinct-volume tmpfs qualified' not in result.stdout:raise RuntimeError('Positive mount qualification marker missing')
finally:
 for target in reversed(mounted):
  result=subprocess.run(['umount',str(target)],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  record['cleanup'].append(dict(target=str(target),exit_code=result.returncode,output=result.stdout))
 leftovers=[line for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if str(fixture) in line]
 record['mounts_after']=leftovers
 if not leftovers:
  for name in ['other','alias','source']:(fixture/name).rmdir()
  fixture.rmdir()
 record['exists_after']=fixture.exists()
 (root/('wp01-location-relation-final-'+mode+'-mount-fixture.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 if leftovers or fixture.exists():raise RuntimeError('Mount fixture cleanup incomplete')

review.windows_failure: Initial and diagnostic fixture attempted directory rename with a retained file inside it. Diagnostic caught std::filesystem::filesystem_error: Access is denied. No production rename is implemented. Final fixture independently moves held file and directory, replaces both old addresses and qualifies both retained identities after the pair ceases to have parent/child membership.
review.freshness: Only native fixture changed after initial library/core build. Final Mac and remote increments compiled/linked that exact fixture; unchanged core input hashes and original compile records retained. Windows touched changed verified input timestamps before building to avoid archive-mtime stale-object reuse.
review.timing: Initial new module: six compile/link steps, Mac 5.677s including CMake regeneration. Final native-only Mac two-step increment 1.572s. Previous native-only Mac increments 1.368/1.437s; this scope fits actual steps. Inspect Linux/Windows records for corresponding native-only timing. Direct sanitizer builds compile all 50 units without project object caches. Previous 49-unit path scope took Mac60.241s, Linux/Windows recorded in prior evidence; first 50-unit Mac build 74.040s, final 90.520s. Commands, unchanged/changed inputs, compile ordering and no object reuse reviewed; no precise cause assigned to timing variation. Freshness is established by sources, commands, output timestamps/hashes and actual native markers, never duration alone.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 unstarted.
Equal reported volume IDs do not uniquely identify a physical volume, rule out mount/subvolume boundaries, or establish native rename support.
Mount IDs are existing STATX_MNT_ID values, not STATX_MNT_ID_UNIQUE. No persistence, atomic snapshot, ancestry, membership, traversal or operation permission claim.
Production assessment performs no I/O and uses cached bookends, retaining both native owners. Reversed/concurrent changes can escape observations.
macOS/Windows Linux-mount relation is Unsupported. Native different-volume and bind-mount qualification here is Linux only; no Windows/macOS cross-volume fixture claimed.

Optional private Linux fixture is unconfigured in broad runs; separately qualified normal and sanitizer runs require its positive marker. It uses isolated private mount namespaces and test-owned empty directories, then unmounts/removes them.
macOS ASan+UBSan with unavailable leak detector disabled; Linux ASan+UBSan with leaks enabled; Windows ASan only.
No application/UI launched, no production content/mutation/probe/elevation API added. Diagnostic outputs removed; verified normal test build and SDK retained.
